title: "VSU Risk Assessment 2026"
format: 
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(lessR)
library(plotly)

options(plotly_suggest = FALSE)

```

```{r}
#| label: data-management
## setting workind environment
setwd(here::here("risk-assessment"))

## load data
risk_dta <- read_excel("data/risk-assessment.xlsx") |> 
    clean_names()
```


## Column - Risk category and rating

### Row - Risk breakdown {height="40%"}

```{r}
#| label: risk rating all
#| title: Risk rating breakdown
#| warning: false
#| message: false

risk_dta |> 
  count(risk_rating) |> 
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n),
         pct_lab = str_c(risk_rating, ": ", round(pct * 100, 2), "%"),
         hover_lab = str_c("Category: ", risk_rating,
                           "<br>Count: ", n,
                           "<br>Share: ", round(pct * 100, 2), "%")) |>
  plot_ly(labels = ~risk_rating, values = ~pct, type = "pie",
          textinfo = "label+percent",      
          textposition = "outside",
          hoverinfo = "text",              
          hovertext = ~hover_lab,          
          marker = list(colors = c("#06d6a0", "#f7f96bee", "#fa9324", "#d62828")),
          hole = 0.5) |>
  layout(title = NULL,
         showlegend = FALSE)

```


### Row - Risk category {height="60%"}

```{r}
#| label: risk category
#| title: Risk category by risk rating

P_risk_category <- 
    risk_dta |> 
    count(risk_category, risk_rating) |> 
    mutate(risk_rating = factor(risk_rating, levels = c("Low", "Tolerable", "High", "Very High"))) |>
    group_by(risk_category) |> 
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(risk_rating = fct_rev(risk_rating)) |> 
    mutate(hover_lab = paste0("Category: ", risk_category,
                            "\nRating: ", risk_rating,
                            "\nCount: ", n,
                            "\nShare: ", round(pct*100, 2), "%")) |> 
    ggplot(aes(pct, risk_category, fill = risk_rating, text = hover_lab)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#d62828", "#fa9324", "#f7f96bee", "#06d6a0")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    labs(
        y = NULL,
        x = NULL,
        fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )

ggplotly(P_risk_category, tooltip = "text")
```


## Column - Risk identified across department

### Row - Risk identified {height="70%"}

```{r}
#| label: risk identified
#| title: Risk identifed across department
#| fig-height: 10

risk_dta |> 
    count(department, risk_rating) |> 
    mutate(risk_rating = factor(risk_rating, levels = c("Low", "Tolerable", "High", "Very High"))) |>
    group_by(department) |> 
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(risk_rating = fct_rev(risk_rating)) |> 
    ggplot(aes(pct, department, fill = risk_rating)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#d62828", "#fa9324", "#f7f96bee", "#06d6a0")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    labs(
        y = NULL,
        x = "Percentage proportion",
        fill = "Rating"
    ) +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
    )
```
